blocks.h2: Signs Your Gas Fireplace Needs Service
blocks.intro: Most gas fireplace problems come down to the pilot, the ignition, the gas supply or dirt that's built up over a season. Watch for:

tiles.h3: The Pilot Won't Light or Stay Lit
tiles.body: A dirty or failing thermocouple or thermopile, a clogged pilot orifice or a gas supply issue can keep the pilot from staying on.
Flames that are low, lazy or leaving soot on the glass point to dirty burners, bad air-to-gas mixture or a venting problem.

tiles.h3: The Fireplace Shuts Off on Its Own
tiles.body: A safety sensor that trips can mean a venting or ignition issue. It's doing its job, and it's worth finding out why.
If you smell gas, turn nothing on or off, get everyone out and call your gas utility or 911 from outside. Once it's safe, call us to find and fix the source.

blocks.h2: Gas Fireplace Repair, Cleaning and Maintenance
blocks.intro: A gas fireplace combines a gas line, a burner and a vent. We work on all three:

steps.body: Pilot and ignition problems, thermocouples and thermopiles, valves, igniters and gas supply issues.
Burner and pilot cleaning, glass cleaning, log and ember placement, a gas leak check and a look at the venting.
New or extended gas lines for a fireplace or insert, installed to code and tested. See [gas line installation](/highland-park/gas-line-installation).

blocks.h2: Gas Fireplaces in Highland Park Homes
blocks.intro: Long Lake County winters mean a gas fireplace in Highland Park gets real use. That's also why it needs regular attention.

items.body: A fireplace that sat all summer can collect dust, spider webs and debris in the burner and pilot. A cleaning and check in the fall keeps it from failing on the first cold night.

Nearly half of Highland Park homes were built before 1960, often with original black iron gas piping. Fireplaces added or converted later may be running on older lines worth checking. See [gas line repair](/highland-park/gas-line-repair).
Any gas appliance needs working venting and a working carbon monoxide detector nearby. If your detector goes off, get out and call for help. We'll check the venting and the appliance once it's safe.

blocks.h2: Why Call J. Blanton for Gas Fireplace Service
blocks.intro: Gas work isn't like fixing a faucet. You can't always tell from the outside whether the job was done right.

steps.body: Gas line work should be done by a licensed pro. Our plumbers are licensed and trained for it.
Your technician explains your options and gives you a flat rate before any money changes hands.
We check for leaks and confirm the fireplace runs safely before we call the job done.

blocks.h2: Gas Fireplace Questions From Highland Park Homeowners

items.q: How often should a gas fireplace be serviced?
items.preview: Once a year, ideally in the fall before heavy use.
items.answer: Once a year is a good rule, ideally in the fall before you start using it. A yearly cleaning and check keeps the pilot, burner and venting working and catches small problems early.

items.q: Why won't my gas fireplace pilot stay lit?
items.preview: Usually a thermocouple, a clogged pilot or a gas supply issue.
items.answer: The most common causes are a dirty or failing thermocouple or thermopile, a clogged pilot orifice or a gas supply problem. Repeatedly relighting it won't fix the cause. We'll find it and fix it.

items.q: What should I do if I smell gas near my fireplace?
items.preview: Get out, call your gas utility or 911 from outside, and don't go back in until it's cleared.
items.answer: Leave immediately and don't switch any lights or electronics on or off. Once you're outside, call your gas utility or 911. Don't go back in until the area has been cleared. Once it's safe, call a licensed plumber to locate and fix the source.

items.q: How much does gas fireplace repair cost?
items.preview: It depends on the problem. A technician gives you a flat rate before anything starts.
items.answer: It depends on what's failed and the parts it needs. We don't price gas work over the phone. A licensed technician looks at the fireplace and gives you a flat rate before anything starts.
